note: Attacker-controlled CWD/CHROOT option path (e.g. "/a") is registered on the parser leak list when the EXPECTPATH WORD token is lexed.

In the options grammar rule, a second chdirspec overwrites the first: free() is called on the previous option string WITHOUT parser_leak_remove() first, so the freed pointer stays linked in parser_leak_list.
The cmndspec rule removes only the final option string from the leak list; the stale freed pointer of the overwritten option remains on the list.
During parser cleanup (init_parser(NULL) -> parser_leak_init -> parser_leak_free), the stale LEAK_PTR entry is freed a second time, causing an ASan-detected double free.
